scenario: The negative half of the divide-by-zero classification, on the same program and steps. A classification claim is two claims — the right kind appears AND the other kinds do not — and the harness asserts one kind per fixture, so the pair is written as two. This one forbids `type_error` (the value is present and the operation is valid at the site; nothing is Json-sourced) and `engine_error` (the engine is intact, so the tier must not halt). Int operands, because only an all-Int division traps ([LEXP.7.15.1]). Same path as the sibling: the Int arm of `DS_RETE_BINOP_DIV`, via `ds_rete_fault`'s DS_FAULT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO arm.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule div:
    S s where s.a / s.b > 1.0
->
    log info "fired"
